situation.rationale: Describe the concrete input, observed output and checks of this reversible evidence tool

a-real-output.note: Four native inputs produce a saved integrity receipt and strict behavior failure; paired review preserves actual outputs.

a-distinguishing.note: Actual trace delivery covers inherited context and unsupported conclusions that file matching cannot establish.

a-absences.quote: This replays existing evidence to avoid another model run.
a-absences.note: Saved evidence replay is intentionally bounded; broad runtime parity remains unproved.

a-run-it.note: Command tested through native process; strict refusal exit1 is expected.

a-use-else.quote: Use fresh native execution when the client, role or required capability changes.
a-use-else.note: Changed runtime inputs require authentic execution and a new bound review.
